text: In 2021, approximately 2.23% of the property's area experienced tree-cover loss. The total affected area was about 81.3 hectares out of the property's total area of 3643.5 hectares. This assessment is based on data from the University of Maryland's Global Forest Change dataset (GFC-2025-v1.13), corroborated by the European Commission Joint Research Centre's Global Forest Cover 2020 data. The loss primarily occurred in planted forests, specifically areas with Pinus elliottii and Pinus taeda species, with no native forest affected.
